preview.title: Analysis preview
preview.cvUnavailable: Continuous tracking and event detection are not available. Unknown stays unknown.

identity.title: Confirm this is you
identity.hint: Select sampled frames that show your jersey. Stats stay unknown until identity is confirmed.
identity.confirmed: Identity confirmed for the selected frames.
identity.rejected: Identity was not confirmed. Countable stats stay unknown.

ask.title: Ask this match
ask.hint: Questions are answered only from stored observations and events. Nothing is invented.
ask.question: Your question
ask.placeholder: e.g. Did you see a shot?

report.title: Match analysis
report.missing: This analysis could not be loaded.
report.statsUnknown: Countable stats stay unknown until validated events exist.
report.cvUnavailable: This view needs computer-vision tracking, which is not deployed.
report.noVideo: No video is available to seek.
report.reelHint: Turn the moments from this report into a private reel draft you can review and edit.

modal.title: Analyze match video
modal.intro: PitchProof samples still frames across your film, asks you to confirm identity, and reports only what those frames support. Tracking and match stats stay unknown without a computer-vision worker.

technique.title: Technique stars
technique.basis: Estimated from sampled still frames on a 1–5 star scale. This is an AI read of a few moments, not a verified rating.
technique.unavailable: This report has no technique assessment. Run a new analysis to get star ratings for weak foot, skill moves and more.
technique.identityRequired: Technique stars need you to confirm which frames show you before the analysis runs. Confirm your identity, then analyse again.
technique.noneRated: The sampled frames did not show enough of you on the ball to give a star rating. Footage closer to the action helps.

quality.title: Analysis quality
quality.canTellTitle: What this analysis can tell you
quality.canTellEmpty: Nothing could be confirmed from this video.

canTell.identity_confirmed: You confirmed the tracked player is you
canTell.visible_share: You were visible for about {{pct}}% of the footage

uncertain.off_camera: About {{pct}}% of the match was likely off camera
uncertain.identity_unconfirmed: The tracked player has not been confirmed as you
uncertain.cv_unavailable: Statistics that need computer vision (not available): {{count}}

sync.title: Sync with GPS
sync.noSessions: No completed GPS session to sync with.
sync.instructions: Choose the GPS session from this match, play the video to the moment you started recording, then mark it.
sync.markNow: Mark current video time as GPS start
sync.pointsUnavailable: Sprint detail is only available for sessions recorded with the current version of PitchProof.
sync.noSprints: No sprints were detected in this session.

modalReport.noCoverage: No reliable player coverage estimate was recorded.

modalReport.applyBlocked: Countable stats stay unknown until your identity is confirmed and validated events exist. Log the match yourself instead.
modalReport.buildReel: Build a highlight reel from this analysis

modalForm.savedBody: The estimated stats were added to your match log.

errors.frames_insufficient: Not enough clear frames of the match could be read. Try a steadier or brighter recording.
errors.model_unavailable: The analysis service is unavailable right now. Your video is saved — try again later.
errors.model_output_invalid: The analysis could not be completed. Your video is saved — try again.
errors.ai_consent_required: AI analysis is turned off. Turn it on in the Privacy Center to analyze footage.
errors.extraction_failed: Key frames could not be extracted from this video.
errors.queue_unavailable: Analysis could not be queued. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.video_rejected: This video did not pass the format and length checks.

pipeline.stageBased: Progress is shown by stage. You can close this screen; the analysis continues on our servers.
pipeline.queued: Waiting in the queue. One full match is analyzed per player at a time.
